text:
riley: proposal: LaunchSprint micro-experiment next week. combo: short benchmark blog + gated 25-credit webinar + 3 small prompt templates. goal = bump 7-day activation and seed SDR leads.
kai: nice. what is the primary KPI?
riley: primary = pct of new signups -> first 3 generation events within 7 days. target uplift 8% vs holdout. secondary = # sales:hot leads from RSVP form.
devon: how are we defining audience?
riley: segment = new signups (0-30d) with zero usage, exclude paid trials. control split = 70/30 holdout:exposed to keep power.
kai: tracking plan? params?
riley: use utm_source=launchsprint&utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=launchsprint_may, add route=starterkit on banner links. RSVP page must capture org size + "enterprise interest" checkbox to tag sales:hot.
devon: credit abuse concern 1  attendance-only grant?
riley: yes, credits (25) only on attendance. workflow "grant_starter_v2" needs approval. ops-bot: workflow "grant_starter_v2" requires manager approval before cohort write.
analytics-bot: remind: please ensure first-gen event payload includes utm + route for attribution.
kai: can we A/B test banner CTA short vs benefit-led? banner only, email stays same.
riley: exactly. banner AB 50/50 for exposed. devon will host a 30m office-hours webinar Tue May 9 09:30.
devon: deck and RSVP page draft by monday. will add hidden route param and tracking.
kai: I'll build the segment and drop CSV in shared drive, and set banner AB.
analytics-bot: I'll prepare funnel dashboard (rsvp->attend->first-gen) and add alert if attend < 30% of RSVPs.
ops-bot: calendar event created: "LaunchSprint: Webinar + Starter Credits" Tue May 9 09:30. Join link in event.
riley: assigning owners: kai = segment + banner AB + export; devon = deck + RSVP + host; analytics-bot = dashboard + alerts; riley = prompt pack + copy + credit approval.
kai: shared drive: https://drive.redwood.example/launchsprint - check perms. I'll spin up AB in the morning.
devon: prompts to include: 1) TL;DR meeting summary, 2) tone-rewrite for docs, 3) brainstorm 5 micro-features. keep each 2-3 lines.
riley: meeting to confirm go/no-go monday 10am. anything else?
kai: small ask 1 add hidden cookie to prevent double-counting across devices.
analytics-bot: noted. will dedupe by user_id in dashboard.
riley: thanks team :rocket:
